No horizontal overflow, page/console errors or off-origin/mutating requests are reported. Both browsers/contexts and the loopback server close.
source_equivalence: Only the browser protocol differs between full-suite source and verified parent; product runtime and manifests are byte-identical. A fresh fixture-only proof binds the corrected protocol. The full suite is not claimed as rerun at this parent.
limits: Safe synthetic read-only observations, not native backup completion, independent thaw, filesystem liveness, prior-active restoration, installed recovery or full authenticated-app acceptance.
